method: Reconstruct published utils gene-label conversion, retain nan/intergenic/self labels as author does, and condition+TNF category>=50 used in author training script. Metadata calculation only; not copied into Opal input eligibility, endpoint or benchmark.
own_scope: Exclude nan, intergenic, ambiguous and self-pairs; per-SampleIndex minimum 10; reference-supported complete panel separately by TNF; differs from author pooled filters.
